speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I see you are here to discuss a skin condition with potential oncologic implications. To begin, can you describe the specific lesion you are concerned about, including its size, color, and any changes you have noticed over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and finger.

Thank you for that detailed history. Given your heavy smoking history, chronic sun exposure potential from immigration, and the specific location and nature of these non-healing, crusty lesions, we need to confirm this immediately. I am requesting a biopsy of the penile lesion and the digital lesion. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy_Penile_Lesion, Biopsy_Finger_Lesion.
